Alex Jones was out of studio on the day when [[Robert Mueller]] gave his press conference, so today, Dan and Jordan stick around in 2013 to continue their look into how Alex behaved in the aftermath of [[The Sandy Hook Elementary Massacre|Sandy Hook]]. In this installment, we learn about a perilous vacation Alex took to Big Bend National Park, experience some real disgraceful bigotry and some equally disgraceful salesmanship.
